slides.sub: Try it before or after a feed!

sections.heading: 1. Swap, lift, shrug
lines: ① Swap the arm you carry on, and your chair.
② Use pillows to raise baby to chest height.
③ Shrug up, then let go: 5 sec × 10 reps.
④ Do it 2–3 times a day, even briefly.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: Your arm tingles or headaches keep building
— see a physio or your GP first.

caption:
New parent, and your shoulders have crept up to your ears? Lulu knows the feeling.

Feeding, rocking and carrying keep your head down and arms forward for hours, often on very little sleep. Small changes can help: swap the arm you carry on, raise baby on pillows during feeds so you can sit back, and look down with your eyes rather than your whole neck.

Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier, and it works well alongside gentle movement rather than replacing it. Pins and needles in the arm or building headaches are worth a physio or GP check first.
